external_validation_status_definitions.not_performed: The external review has not been performed. The project's internal state is the source of truth.
external_validation_status_definitions.pending_external_review: The external review is scheduled or anticipated but has not yet been performed.
external_validation_status_definitions.in_progress_external: The external review is in progress. The reviewer is in the middle of their work. (Claude review is in this state.)
external_validation_status_definitions.completed: The external review is complete. The reviewer's output has been filed. (No external review is in this state at this time.)

no_go_claim_risk_definitions.none: The question's answer, if not handled carefully, would not lead to a no-go claim.
no_go_claim_risk_definitions.low: The question's answer requires context to avoid a no-go claim.
no_go_claim_risk_definitions.medium: The question's answer requires context and no-go claim enforcement.
no_go_claim_risk_definitions.high: The question's answer is on a topic that is frequently misread; the reviewer is explicitly reminded of the no-go list.

expected_answer_type_definitions.factual: The answer is a factual statement of the project's internal state. The reviewer reports the project's self-assessment.
expected_answer_type_definitions.narrative: The answer is a narrative description of how the project works. The reviewer reports the project's narrative.
expected_answer_type_definitions.judgment: The answer is the reviewer's own judgment. The reviewer applies their expertise to assess the project's posture.
expected_answer_type_definitions.opinion: The answer is the reviewer's own opinion. The reviewer expresses their view.
